subject: Demo recap & proposed pilot charter — Haven Health
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Grant <alex@havenhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@havenhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0500
Subject: Demo recap & proposed pilot charter — Haven Health

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Great conversation and appreciate you walking us through the ingestion and de-identification workflow you run for clinical notes. Per our discussion, attached is a short pilot charter that outlines scope, success criteria, roles, and a 6-week proposed timeline so your team can evaluate Redwood in a representative way. High-level summary below.

Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for secure PHI-safe summarization and extraction at 50k tokens/day with sub-500ms tail latency on 1-2 regionally hosted nodes.

Proposed pilot (summary)
- Duration: 6 weeks (2-week kickoff + 3-week evaluation window + 1-week wrap)
- Test workload: daily batch of de-identified clinical notes (50–75k tokens/day), plus ad-hoc 1:1 summarization API calls for clinician UI (p99 latency target)
- Success criteria (pass/fail):
  1) Extraction accuracy: entity recall >= 88% on the evaluation prompt set (we'll seed with 150 labeled samples you provide)
  2) Latency: p95 <= 300ms, p99 <= 500ms on clinician UI path under 25 RPS
  3) Cost baseline: tokens cost <= 0.35 USD per 1k tokens using suggested batching/quantization config
  4) Security & compliance: private VPC connectivity + audit logs retained for 90 days
- Ownership:
  - Redwood: runtime, model ops, trial provisioning, SLO monitoring (Ava)
  - Haven Health: sample data set, label set for accuracy eval, network approvals (Alex / Priya)

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Sign the pilot charter / SOW (attached) or confirm edits — we can convert to DocuSign;
2) Haven sends initial 150 labeled samples or a minimal synthetic set by Mon 11/23 so we can start runbooks;
3) Redwood provision trial staging in us-east-1 and share test endpoints + cost dashboard by 11/24;
4) Kickoff call week of 11/30 to align on metrics and measurement.

Attachments: redwood-trial-charter-havenhealth.pdf, haven-health-success-metrics.xlsx

If that looks good I'll loop in engineering for provisioning. Thanks again — enjoyed the session.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed pilot charter — Haven Health

Thanks Ava — very thorough and helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side before we commit: 

1) Data: we cannot share PHI samples. Can you run the initial 150-labeled samples against a synthetic dataset we generate, or work off fully de-identified extracts? We will have a compliance review.
2) Latency targets: the clinician UI requires p95 <= 200ms for interactive flows. I know you mentioned 300ms — is that achievable with a smaller model variant or edge routing?
3) Cost: 0.35 USD per 1k tokens is higher than our goal. Can Redwood give a run-rate estimate at projected 50k tokens/day using batching + 8-bit quantization?

Also, can you confirm what logs we will have access to during the pilot (request-level traces, token counts, audit events)?

Assuming those answers are reasonable, I think we can proceed to sign a short SOW. Would prefer kickoff on 11/30 as suggested.

—Alex
Alex Grant

Alex — quick follow from pricing/ops perspective. I ran rough estimates against the 50k tokens/day profile using our batching and q8_0 quantization recommendations. Ballpark numbers below (open to refinement once we have exact token counts):

Estimated run-rate (50k tokens/day)
- Hosted pilot (dedicated pool, us-east-1): ~ $0.28 per 1k tokens => ~$14/day => ~$420/month
- Private deployment (single VPC node with audit logging): setup + monthly baseline expected to be ~ $3,500/month (includes 90-day log retention)

Latency notes:
- For interactive clinician UI p95 <= 200ms we recommend a local routing policy to a lower-latency variant (smaller context, trimmed prompt templates) — achievable with the dedicated pool and per-route routing. Ava will include config details in the provisioning runbook.

Logs & telemetry access:
- You will get request-level traces, token counts per request, KC cache hit rates, and audit events for admin-level access. Kept for 90 days in the pilot dashboard; extended retention is an add-on.

If those estimates look in range, I can draft a short SOW amendment for DocuSign and we can target kickoff 11/30.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks Ava and Ben — that answers our questions.

1) Data: we'll provide a fully de-identified synthetic set (150 records) by COB Mon 11/23. Compliance has pre-approved synthetic datasets for pilots.
2) Latency: 200ms p95 sounds reasonable if you route the clinician UI to the smaller variant; please include the routing policy in the runbook.
3) Cost: $0.28 per 1k tokens for the hosted pilot is acceptable — please include the breakdown in the SOW.

Next steps:
- Ben to share a DocuSign SOW draft today;
- Haven to deliver synthetic sample set by 2026-11-23 COB;
- Redwood to provision staging and share endpoints + dashboard by 2026-11-24;
- Kickoff call is confirmed for 2026-11-30 (send invite)

I'll look out for the SOW. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Alex
